rule: Structural-home role keying and token carriage
description: `plugin/governance/remediation-doctrine.md` `## Defer-with-Scope` defines "structural home" as a ROLE rather than a destination TYPE. The source pin is ONE span carrying BOTH halves of that rule — the role definition (the term names a role, not a destination type; the tail's reasoning has a durable home; the admissible destinations are the two defined in that section, Tracked issue and Recorded residual) and the obligation that definition triggers (a restatement must carry BOTH destinations and cite that section, and binding the role noun to a single destination type is the FORBIDDEN form). Both halves are pinned together because either one alone leaves the other rewritable: a definition-only pin stays green while the prohibition is deleted, and a prohibition-only pin stays green while the role is re-keyed back to a destination type. The consumers pin the TOKEN only, never remedy prose, so honest rewording of the doctrine body does not break them: `plugin/skills/detect-remediation-signals/SKILL.md` must still emit `structural-home` as a member of the `advisory_reason` enum, `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` must still carry that same enum on its `merge-advised` output contract, `plugin/agents/overlord.md` must still render the role-named `structural home: <structural_home>` field in the merge advisory it surfaces to the user, and `plugin/skills/github-review-loop/SKILL.md` must still transport `structural_home` alongside `advisory_reason` and `recommendation_text`. Those four tokens are the end-to-end carriage of the role-keyed value from detector to user; dropping it from any one file is loud. What this pin honestly guarantees is exactly that these word sequences exist in these five named files; it claims nothing about meaning. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a prose re-narrowing that leaves the pinned bytes intact is invisible — surrounding text that reintroduces a destination-type restatement elsewhere in the same file, or that treats the carried value as a tracker entry while the pinned sentence stands, stays green; (2) the destination enumeration, the restatement remedy, and the forbidden-form EXAMPLE all sit inside the pinned span because a single span must be contiguous to carry both halves, so rewording or extending any of them turns the suite red even when the rule itself is unchanged — an accepted cost of pinning the definition and the prohibition together; (3) the pin sees only the five files it names, and a further consumer that drops its token is invisible here. The pinned rule asserts nothing about files it does not name, so drift in an unnamed consumer is outside this pin's scope by design and is tracked separately.

source.pattern: names a ROLE, not a destination type: the tail's reasoning has a durable home. The admissible destinations are the two defined above — Tracked issue and Recorded residual. A restatement must carry BOTH and cite this section; binding the role noun to a single destination type ("a tracked structural home") re-narrows the role and is the forbidden form.
